title: Renewal Payment Amount on Premium Billing Accounts: The Balance Due
content:
**Statement.** On Premium Billing Accounts, the renewal payment is the account's balance due, rounded half up to the cent and never less than 0.00.

**The balance due** is every invoice, returned payment, returned-payment fee and refund booked on the account, less every payment received and every premium credit booked.

| Adds to the balance due | Reduces the balance due |
|---|---|
| invoices | payments received |
| returned payments | premium credits |
| returned-payment fees | |
| refunds issued | |

**Worked example (hypothetical ledger).** Invoices booked over the account's life total 2,148.60; one returned payment of 1,087.32 and its returned-payment fee of 25.00; payments received total 2,174.64; a premium credit of 12.40.
Balance due: 2,148.60 plus 1,087.32 plus 25.00, less 2,174.64, less 12.40, giving 1,073.88. Renewal payment: 1,073.88.

Had the payments and credits exceeded the charges, leaving a balance of minus 30.15 (a credit balance), the renewal payment would be 0.00.
